CIQ MenuCompound

Connector IQ content + skills palette, in two variants: (1) inline below the composer — opens by typing “/”; and (2) a centered “Add content” modal with a title + Search — opens from the Add menu. Both share a pill Tablist (All · Skills · Files · People · Meetings · Emails · Chats · Sites · Other) over a scrolling list of MenuListItem rows: content items (icon + label + timestamp) or skill items (icon + “/name” title + description). Selecting a row attaches it to the composer as a pill. Composes Dialog + Tab/TabList + MenuListItem + Attachment Pill.

Add content
Two variants of the same palette. Inline (below the composer): type "/" to focus Skills; click a row to attach it as a pill. Modal ("Add content"): opens from the Add menu with a title + Search over the pill Tablist. Both use MenuListItem rows — content (label + timestamp) or skill (/name + description).
